## Budget-controlled Master File pilot
This controller selects at most six complete paper pairs. It runs them sequentially, pauses for 10 minutes after paper 5, and stops at a $3 batch / $15 campaign OpenAI ceiling.

After importing both workflows, select **Shamo Budget v1 - IGCSE 0606 Stage One Paper** inside **Run One Paper Sub-workflow**.
